# BAD-034 — worktree-init.sh should link admin/node_modules like the root one

## Brief
scripts/worktree-init.sh links the root node_modules and every voicepack into a fresh worktree, but not admin/node_modules, and admin/ is its own npm package with its own dependency tree. A worktree that touches admin/ therefore cannot run its typecheck, lint or build, and the parallel-worktrees skill forbids npm install inside a worktree, so the fix is a symlink to the main checkout's admin/node_modules, made the same way and reported the same way as the root link (present, newly linked, or a real directory that RELINK=1 replaces). Evidence: BAD-031's worktree, created by EnterWorktree on 2026-09-14 and wired by the script, reported node_modules linked and 23 voicepacks linked, while ls admin/node_modules said No such file or directory; Spud linked it by hand before the scout could verify. Also mention the admin link in the parallel-worktrees skill's list of what the script wires.

## Size, persona and model decision
One scout on haiku or one engineer on sonnet: a few lines of shell in scripts/worktree-init.sh plus one sentence in .claude/skills/parallel-worktrees/SKILL.md. Proof: run the script in a fresh worktree and show admin/node_modules is a symlink; run it again and show it is idempotent.
